caption: : Eval PPL. under different Shared Sub-Dim ratio settings.
model_annotation: This plot illustrates the evaluation perplexity (PPL) values under varying shared sub-dimensions to total sub-dimensions ratios. The x-axis is labeled "Shared Sub-Dims / Total Sub-Dims" and uses a linear scale ranging from 0/4 to 4/4, with tick labels spaced at intervals of 0.25, representing divisions of the total scale. The y-axis, labeled "Eval PPL," utilizes a linear scale from approximately 11.0 to 12.5, with tick increments of 0.5. A dashed red line represents the Transformer model, exhibiting a steady decline from a value of approximately 12.0 at x=0/4 to a value of approximately 11.0 at x=4/4. A solid blue line represents the Mo HD model, starting at a value of approximately 11.2 at x=0/4, decreasing to approximately 10.8 at x=4/4, and showing a peak value of approximately 11.5 at x=2/4.
